name: GoldenPad

inputs.description: Your own US retail GoldenEye 007 ROM (normalized SHA-1 abe01e4aeb033b6c0836819f549c791b26cfde83). The primary build converts it privately and translates it with N64Recomp; the app also imports it on first launch.

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install Xcode and its iOS platform

notes: No single personal-build command exists yet. Documented steps: scripts/bootstrap-sources.sh, TLB-free conversion with GoldenEye64Recomp's pinned xdelta, scripts/generate-recomp-inputs.sh, runtime and RT64 archive builds, scripts/build-recomp-apple.sh ios, then packaging. See docs/BUILDING.md and docs/RT64_N64RECOMP_PROTOTYPE.md.

publication.reason: The primary app contains game code translated from the player's ROM; public releases are source only.
